JUST IN: The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) welcomes the appointment of former Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen. Nicolas Torre III as the new MMDA General Manager.

In an official statement, the agency expresses its full support to the decision of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. in his trust for Gen. Torre, whose extensive experience in public service and law enforcement is expected to further strengthen the MMDA’s mandate in traffic management and public safety, among others, across Metro Manila.

MMDA Chairman Atty. Don Artes says, "Gen. Torre is a welcome addition to the MMDA family. I am sure he will be a big help to the agency." 

The MMDA has also extended its sincere appreciation to former General Manager Procopio Lipana for his dedication and valuable contributions to MMDA for more than three years. 

The agency says they remain committed to continuing its mission of ensuring safe, efficient, and orderly mobility and development in Metro Manila with the appointment of Gen. Torre.

Stuck in traffic? You’re definitely not alone. As the Friday holiday rush hits full throttle, millions of motorists are crawling through Metro Manila’s most congested roads. But where is traffic at its absolute worst?

This map shows the average traffic congestion levels (%) across Metro Manila and nearby areas at 6:00 PM on Fridays, typically the peak of the week’s traffic, based on the TomTom Traffic Index. At this hour, driving just 10 kilometers can take around 44 minutes.

While the region is already heavily congested at an average of 88% congestion, the area around Ortigas, Pasig City, stands out as the most gridlocked hotspot at 123%. #Christmas2025 #rushhour #trafficsafety
